title: Bisikan di Jalur Terlupakan
theme: Menjelajahi sudut tersembunyi di lingkungan yang akrab, memicu rasa ingin tahu dan penemuan hal-hal baru yang terlupakan yang memberi perspektif segar.

cover.prompt: An overgrown railway path stretching into the distance, framed by lush green foliage and a thick canopy of leaves on the suburban outskirts. Bright, warm dappled sunlight illuminates the scene, filtering through the dense vegetation. A solitary figure is subtly present, perhaps a silhouette or seen from behind, walking on the pathway, suggesting quiet exploration and discovery. Emphasize the serene beauty of natural reclamation. Cinematic composition with rule of thirds, leading lines, and a sense of depth.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Rio, seorang freelancer, menjelajahi jalur bekas rel kereta yang terlupakan. Ia menemukan plang misterius dan reruntuhan kuno, memicu rasa ingin tahu dan menginspirasinya dengan cerita masa lalu.
meta.target_emotion: Rasa ingin tahu, kedamaian, apresiasi terhadap sejarah.
